description: Find individual SHOTS inside commercials by what is in the frame ("hand pouring beer in slow motion", "car drifting at night in the rain", "family laughing at a kitchen table"), with shot tags (size, angle, setting, time of day, lighting, mood, people, product / logo visible) and any commercial-level filter (brand, director, agency, award show, year…). Each shot has its still, a short clip of just that shot, its tags and a link to the exact moment.
